scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/world && esbuild src/functions/world.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/world/index.js && cp src/data/world.json dist/world/world.json && cd dist/world && zip -q ../world.zip index.js world.json && cd ../.. && rm -rf dist/world
scripts.dev: npm run build && sam local start-api --template template.yaml
